checks.reason: Positive inhibition/vehicle or inactive-compound comparisons are specified prospectively with roles testing functional assay response and background; these are sufficient biological/procedural controls at essay scope, distinct from missing measurement calibration.

No plan to consult prior experimental Methods/supplements or validated protocols and check condition transfer before executing follow-up assays. Bibliographic authentication does not meet this distinct requirement.
No product-reference/blank recovery or dynamic-range calibration with an acceptance criterion and failed-calibration action.
The proposed measurement lacks a complete quantitative endpoint with units/denominator, background and weak/saturated/missing-signal rules.

checks.quote: the direct ribosomal claim is disproven or at least not supported
checks.reason: Does not condition the negative inference on active assay/sensitivity and distinguish technical failure from biologic noninhibition; a positive-control label alone is not a decision criterion.

Allows whole translation with factors or unspecified reporter without specifying a minimal loaded-substrate comparison, independently measured product or factor counter-assay; this does not isolate peptide-bond chemistry.
